parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the custom rule.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which you want to sort the custom rules. Valid values:

- desc: descending order

- asc: ascending order

parameters.name: OrderField
parameters.description:
The field that you use to sort the custom rules. Valid values:

- GmtModified: sorts the rules by modification time.

- Id: sorts the rules by rule ID. This is the default value.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is deployed. You must select the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- **ap-southeast-1**: your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID that is used to switch the administrator's view to the view of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all members in the enterprise.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the rule. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and periods (.).

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

- **predefine**: predefined

- **customize**: custom

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

- **0**: initial

- **10**: testing with simulated data

- **15**: testing with business data

- **20**: testing with business data is complete

- **100**: published

parameters.name: ThreatLevel
parameters.description:
The threat level. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

- **serious**: high

- **suspicious**: medium

- **remind**: low
